core.title: Dummy 13-1/2 Inch Warwick Handleset, Acorn WT7BD

text.description_html:
Acorn WT7BD, Dummy 13-1/2" Warwick Lockset

Most often used on the inactive side of double doors, dummy handlesets neither latch nor lock. Acorn's Dummy 13-1/2" Warwick Handleset features a fake thumbturn and a blank cylinder to match with the Single Cylinder Mortise Handleset. The rough black iron finish of the Warwick Handleset duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron making it perfect for restoration projects and colonial-style homes.

Dummy Handleset: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Also Available Matching:
13-1/2" Warwick Single Cylinder Mortise Handleset
13-1/2" Warwick Double Cylinder Mortise Handleset

Features of the 13-1/2" Warwick Dummy Lockset:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Package Includes: Interior and exterior handle, dummy thumbturn, dummy cylinder, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WT7BD Dummy 13-1/2" Warwick Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior Blank Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior Blank Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Length: 13-1/2"
  • Exterior and Interior Handle Width: 3-1/4"

Sold Individually
